messages:
zoe: Quick heads-up: CI flaky after secrets rotation — only one repo kept failing auth. Repro below.

amir: Which repo?

zoe: customer-demo. We rotate REDWOOD_API_KEY nightly, but the running container still used RW_LEGACY_TOKEN (old env).

lucy: Oof. Did someone pin an old SDK?

zoe: Yes, demo pinned @redwood/sdk-go v0.3.2 which prefers legacy names. Snippet from runtime: `const key = env.RW_LEGACY_TOKEN || env.REDWOOD_API_KEY || env.REDWOOD_SERVICE_KEY`

sam: That precedence makes rotation non-atomic if CI only replaces REDWOOD_API_KEY. Ops ended up with two secrets.

infra-bot: CI job #9201 failed: https://ci.internal/9201 601 unauthorized

amir: Short-term: update deploy scripts to write all known env names (REDWOOD_API_KEY, REDWOOD_SERVICE_KEY, RW_LEGACY_TOKEN) when running rotate-key, so pinned SDKs pick up new token.

lucy: Agreed. Also add a tiny compat shim in the SDK that logs a single-line deprecation warning when legacy envs exist and points to migration doc.

zoe: I can PR the demo to include a SIGHUP handler that re-inits auth so containers don't have to fully restart when secrets change.

sam: We should also add an e2e in demo-ci: run rotate-key, send a test request, ensure 200 after restart. That would catch pinned-sdk regressions.

amir: Longer term: RFC for SDK parity across languages defining canonical env precedence (recommend REDWOOD_API_KEY first) and runtime guidance for streaming: prefer per-connection auth at handshake; on auth failure, fail fast and require reconnect.

lucy: I'll draft the onboarding "CI secret hygiene" blurb with GH Actions + GitLab snippets showing how to rotate single secret and remove legacy ones.

offline: Created issues: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-go/issues/212, https://github.com/redwood-inference/demo-repo/issues/56

sam: Plan: 1) emergency rotate-helper patch to dual-write recognized envs, 2) demo PR for SIGHUP + e2e, 3) SDK compat shim + docs, 4) RFC for parity + runtime streaming note.

zoe: Thanks all  this would've been bad if it hit production. Will open the helper PR now.
